thread:
jessica: quick note — after rolling quantized-v2 to the eval bench we see a regression on some long-form golden prompts (mainly multi-turn instructions + code). top-level delta: ~6% BLEU drop on the golden subset. :frowning:
arjun: thanks for flagging. do we know if it's specific to sequence length or certain tokens? any examples?
jessica: short repros: multi-step code-writing prompts, prompt length 800-1500 tokens. examples in the tmp bucket: gs://redwood-evals/1889504321/regressions.txt
maria: is this on the deduped golden or raw collection? still possible collisions due to paraphrases.
arjun: ran a quick fingerprint diff — looks like ~12% of those examples had near-duplicates in the training derivs. suspect KV cache interaction with quant kernels on long sequences.
label-bot: QC summary for golden-refresh run:
- total checked: 240
- regressed: 18
- flaky: 6
- high-severity: 3
sam: if it's a kernel-level quant artifact we should fallback the long-sequence route to float32 variant in routing rules until we patch. can we get a per-route routing override?
jessica: yes — we can add policy: if seq_len>1024 route->float-v1. but want to avoid capacity blowout.
tanaka: alternative: tune the quant calibration for attention scales for long prefix patterns. but that's slower.
arjun: also worth verifying dedup threshold — current fingerprint jaccard <=0.8 might be too lenient. I propose a quick re-run with stricter deduping script (fingerprint + ngram-shingle).
jessica: please drop the script here and i'll run on the golden subset.
arjun: snippet i used:
```bash
python scripts/fingerprint_dedup.py \
  --input gs://redwood-evals/golden_raw.jsonl \
  --out gs://redwood-evals/golden_deduped.jsonl \
  --min_jaccard 0.6 \
  --shingle_k 5
```
maria: if we tighten to 0.6 we might lose borderline paraphrase coverage. can we tag removed items into a "paraphrase-hold" cohort so labelers can review?
arjun: yep output includes field "action":"removed" with original candidate ids. easy to spin up a review queue.
sam: capacity question — labeler pool for this week is at ~40% spare. we can schedule a small relabel batch (up to 300 examples) tomorrow morning PST.
label-bot: scheduled review queue "golden-paraphrase-review-188950" with 300 slots, ETA 2025-08-14 10:00 PST.
jessica: thanks — for the regen/eval plan: (1) dedup stricter -> produce golden_deduped_v2 (2) send 300 borderline to labelers for parity check (3) re-run quantized-v2 eval on v2 set + fallback route test
maria: add a unit test for streaming KV correctness — some regressions only show when streaming + long prefix.
tanaka: i'll add a focused replay with token-level traces to reproduce the attention scaling differences. will post logs to same bucket.
arjun: for the eval, can we include both EM/bleu and a human-rated "instruction-following" score? autometrics alone are noisy for long-code tasks.
jessica: yes put a short rubric in the review task: correctness of final code, preserved step order, no hallucinated APIs. use 3-level scale.
maria: also: flag style regressions (e.g., drops in concise docstrings) as low-severity but track.
sam: ops question — if we enable fallback routing for seq_len>1k, how do we measure cost delta? need a quick estimator.
jessica: i can run a simulated traffic pass on 24h sample and estimate token-by-token cost diff. will post numbers by EOD.
label-bot: reminder: past golden refreshes, ~0.8% of examples got relabeled and changed the eval pass/fail boundary.
arjun: small gotcha — when we rerun with stricter dedup, ensure seeding is deterministic so cohort splits match for A/B.
tanaka: ack. adding seed param to sampler: --random_seed 42
maria: question on labeling rubric: do we accept partial correctness if major steps present? need a clear binary vs graded decision.
jessica: we'll use graded (0/1/2) for now; A/B gating uses >=1 as pass but we'll surface distribution.
sam: ops aside — can we throttle the canary to 5% while we iterate? mitigates user impact.
jessica: yes will set canary weight 5% and enable automatic rollback on 3% regression on key metrics.
arjun: one more: add a small synthetic adversarial set with repeated prompt prefixes to stress KV cache boundary conditions.
tanaka: creating synthetic set now -> gs://redwood-evals/188950/synthetic_kv_stress.jsonl
jessica: plan looks good. next steps: arjun runs dedup -> jessica runs simulated cost & canary change -> label pool does 300 review -> tanaka runs traces -> re-eval quantized-v2 + fallback. updates in this thread. :thumbsup:
maria: thanks — i'll draft the review rubric and ping the labelers.
label-bot: task created: "golden-paraphrase-review-188950" assigned to cohort A (300 examples) — due 48h.
sam: i'll schedule the canary change window for morning deploy.
jessica: posting final items in the bucket: gs://redwood-evals/1889504321/ (dedup script, regressions, rubric)
arjun: noted. will post dedup output by +3h.
jessica: awesome, appreciate the quick turn. :rocket:
